chapter.verse: Hauhna sangin min hoihna deihhuai zaw a, kham leh ngun sangin mi’ hong thusimna deihhuai zaw hi.
A hau a zawng a kilamdan’na om lo hi; a nih tuak-in Topa ’ bawlsa ahi uh hi.
Mipilte in a lauhuai thu mu thei-in pelh uh a, mi mawkmawkte in phu suakin thuak uh hi.
Kiniamkhiat-a, Topa zahtakna thaman in, hauhna, minthan’na, leh khan’sauna ahi hi.
Migilote’ lampi-ah thang kisiahin so kidawh a, mipilte in tua lampi pelh uh hi.
Naupang khat a neu lai-in lampi man tawnsak lecin, a teek dongin lam pial nawn lo ding hi.
Mihaute in mizawngte uk a, leitawi a late in a piate’ sila suak hi.
Thuman lo khaici a vawhte in lungkhamna tuak a, amau’ hehna ciangduai amau’ tung mah tu kik hi.
A cingh mite in mizawngte an pia a, amah in thupha ngah kik hi.
Mi kiphasakte hawlkhia lecin, kitotna leh kisimmawhna bei ding hi.
Lungsim siangtho tawh kamsiamna in kumpipa’ lawm hong suaksak hi.
Topa in thuman mite kem a, ahi zongin thuzuau gente lawnkhia hi.
Mi thadahte inn-ah lumlum a, “pua pial leeng humpi’n hong hih kha’n teh,” ci uh hi.
Numei tunga mawhna in thangzak bang hi a, tua thang ah a awkte tungah Topa heh hi.
Naupangte a hai gamtat a ngeina hi a, deihsak-a satna in mihoih suaksak thei hi.
Hauh nop manin mihaute letsong pia leeng kizawn’lawh a, hauh nop manin mizawngte’ neihsa laksak leeng zong kihauhlawh tuan lo hi.
Na bil uh hong ngatin, mipilte’ thugen ngai un la, ka hong hilh pilna thute na lungsim uh ah lut sak un.
Na lungsim uh ah cing-in zang thei le uh cin, na lung uh dam tawntung ding hi.
Tua hi leh Topa muan’in na nei ding uh a, tu ni-in note’ phattuam nading kam pau ka suak ding hi.
Thuhilhna leh pilna thu nam sawmthum, hih lai munah note’ adingin ka gel a,
note hong sawlte tungah thuman na gen kik theih nadingun, thuman na theih nading uh ka deihna ahi hi.
Bangmah hong hih zo lo ding cihna tawh nuamtak sa-in, mizawngte’ neihsa mawksut kei in la, zum-ah khia-in mawk bawlsiat kei in.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in amaute pan’pih ding a, amau a bawlsiate tungah phu laksak ding hi.
A hehbaih mite tawh kipawl kei in la, a lungtom mite tawh kikhawl kei in.
Amau’ hoih lohnate na zuih khak loh nading na kidop kei leh, nangmah in zong na awk-lawh kha ding hi.
Midangte’ leiba lohsak dingin kamciamin, leiba tavuan la kha kei in.
A leiba lohsak zo kei lecin, na lupna nangawn hong kidawh khiatsak ding hi.
Na pu na pate’ phuhsa gi-suang, cik mah hunin khin kei in.
Ama nasepna-ah a siam mahmah mi na thei kha hiam? amah in mi mawkmawkte’ na sem lo ding a, kumpite’ na sem ding hi.
